decision_cruda.rationale: Radio and CMMS agree on both failures (LH-01 back ~13:30, LH-05 ~11:30). Send LH-08 from the cheap infrastructure heading (0.4 oz/h) to C590-09, 16.5 g/t, 256 t: about 195 t at 30 t/h is roughly 100 oz. Send LH-10 from the workshop once PM ends at 10:00 to C538-06, 6.9 g/t: about 40 oz. Do not touch the critical-path heading (LH-09, 5.7 oz/h). Central stockpile at 303/450 and trucks at 91 t/h can absorb the extra ore.

violaciones: LH-10 no se puede prestar (caído, en mantenimiento o en ciclo combinado)
